reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Improved the memory footprint of the `istio-cni-node` DaemonSet", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: The DaemonSet uses less memory; no operator action required to receive this improvement.

proposed.statement: The `istio-cni-node` DaemonSet has improved memory footprint, potentially resulting in up to 80% memory reduction in many cases.
